user.title: Aquecimento Ninjas
user.description: Per-room heating with Better Thermostat (required). Up to 5 radiator valves in total.

data_description.boiler_mode: Use a thermostat you already have (e.g. generic_thermostat) or let the integration create one.

boiler.title: Boiler
boiler.description: Choose how the boiler is controlled.

data_description.boiler_climate: Climate entity that fires the boiler. Set its target sensor to the 'Reference temperature' sensor of this integration.
data_description.boiler_switch: Switch that turns the boiler on. Optional for an existing thermostat (used for the statistics).
data_description.cold_tolerance: Boiler turns on when the reference temperature is this much below the target.
data_description.hot_tolerance: Boiler turns off when the reference temperature is this much above the target.
data_description.min_cycle: Minimum time the boiler stays on or off. 5 minutes is recommended.
data_description.emergency_pin: Numeric PIN (4 to 8 digits) asked before the emergency button in the Maintenance panel turns the boiler on, ignoring all sensors. Empty = button disabled.
data_description.emergency_hours: The boiler is turned off automatically after this time.

room.title: Room {room_number}
room.description: Valves used: {valves_used} of {valves_max}. A room with two radiators uses one Better Thermostat with both valves.

data_description.climate: Create it first in Better Thermostat with the same valves and room sensor.
data_description.valves: The valves controlled by that Better Thermostat (counted for the 5-valve limit).
data_description.batteries: Optional. Used for the dashboard and low-battery notifications.
data_description.windows: Optional. Used for the dashboard and open-window notifications.

data.notify_not_heating: Notify when a room is not heating

data_description.persons: Optional. When everyone is away for the delay, away mode turns on; it turns off when someone arrives.
data_description.battery_threshold: Notify when a configured battery sensor falls below this percentage.

data_description.enable_away_target: When off, the Away mode switch remains available but does not apply its target temperature.
data_description.enable_master: When off, the master switch does not force the boiler or room thermostats on or off.
data_description.max_runtime_hours: 0 disables the safety limit. When enabled, heating turns off after this many continuous hours.

data.enable_windows: Pause heating when a window is open

data_description.schedule_entity: Select an existing Schedule helper. When active, the integration selects Comfort; when inactive, it selects Eco.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Creates a dashboard with the views Heating and Charts.

data_description.dashboard_style: Enhanced uses Mushroom cards (and ApexCharts, mini-graph and Scheduler cards when installed). Automatic picks Enhanced when Mushroom is installed.

create_dashboard.name: Recreate dashboard
create_dashboard.description: Recreates the Aquecimento Ninjas dashboard from the current configuration. Manual edits are overwritten.

start_boost.name: Start boost
start_boost.description: Heats only the rooms selected for boost to the boost temperature; the other rooms are turned off. Everything is restored when it ends.

hours.name: Duration
hours.description: Hours. Default: the Boost duration setting.

stop_boost.name: Stop boost
stop_boost.description: Ends the boost and restores the previous state.

boost_no_rooms.message: Select at least one room for the boost.

emergency_no_pin.message: Set an emergency PIN first (Settings > Boiler).

emergency_locked.message: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in a few minutes.
